parallel.requirements: Reimplement sd from observed binary behavior and bundled docs only, covering CLI parsing, regex and replacement semantics, file I/O, preview, flags, and build delivery.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent created local tasks and kept implementation/assembly ownership while launching one workflow for six exhaustive probe domains plus corpus generation and one direct help-rendering subagent.
parallel.implementation: Parent wrote a std-only Rust Cargo project with custom regex utf8, unicode, parse, compile, vm, and mod modules, plus compile.sh, while children produced behavior specs.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Final workspace contained Cargo.toml, src/regex modules, compile.sh, executable, docs, and generated files, but the workflow aggregate and corpus were not integrated before closure.
parallel.verification: Parallel performed many local probes and child self-checks; the planned differential corpus was in the killed workflow, and official evaluation failed at compile time.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out with empty final.txt, killed workflow result null, replacement/fileio children still in progress or retry, and official compile_failed with 869 tests not run.

serial.requirements: Reimplement sd from observed binary behavior and bundled docs only under the same prompt restrictions, without source lookup, wrapping, or binary analysis.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Single agent performed all probing, design, Unicode data extraction, regex implementation, replacement logic, CLI parsing, and assembly with workflows and delegation disabled.
serial.implementation: Serial wrote Cargo.toml, tools/dump_ucd.pl, src/ucd.txt, regex modules under src/rx, replacer.rs, and cli.rs as a std-only Rust implementation.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Serial packaged a Rust project and executable in the artifact, but artifact validation was false and official evaluation later failed to compile.
serial.verification: Serial ran local behavioral probes and some checks while implementing, but did not reach a complete evaluator-aligned build verification before timeout.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out with empty final.txt and official compile_failed with all 869 tests not run; defects are ordinary incomplete implementation rather than coordination failures.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run recognized that it had to reimplement the provided sd binary from observation and bundled docs only, without source lookup or wrapping.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run received and followed the same reverse-engineering prompt and restrictions for the same sd task.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference is evidenced; both attempted the same CLI/regex/file behavior reimplementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel parent created local task tracking, kept implementation ownership, and delegated broad probing/help work to one workflow plus one direct subagent.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial control had workflows and task tools disabled and proceeded as a single owner through probing and implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel split behavioral discovery across child agents while serial kept all discovery and code ownership in one trajectory.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow gave detailed domain probes and intended children to write specs into shared /tmp/sdspec, with the corpus phase to read those specs later.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run had no child handoffs or cross-agent interfaces; all findings stayed in the main trajectory before implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced child briefs, shared spec paths, and workflow result aggregation boundaries that do not exist in serial.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel parent wrote Cargo.toml, compile.sh, and several custom regex modules while children probed behavior in the background.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run wrote a Cargo project, Unicode data, regex HIR/parser/program/executor modules, a replacer, and then cli.rs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both built std-only Rust reimplementations, but the serial implementation path is wholly local while parallel mixed local coding with unfinished child-probe work.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow parent received some child results inside workflow state, but the aggregate workflow result remained null when killed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial control had no child results to join; progress and findings were consumed directly by the same agent.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had an unreturned aggregate child-result lifecycle; serial had no retrieval boundary and failed without child lifecycle loss.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel subagents shared /tmp/sdspec despite unique-scratch instructions, and at least one subagent observed another agent clobbered its work files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote and tested in one process without parallel subagent shared-state collisions.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a concrete temporary-artifact contamination episode; serial had no concurrent artifact channel.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel delegated extensive behavioral probing and intended a differential corpus, but the corpus phase did not return and official evaluation later failed to compile.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial performed local probes and wrote code, but official evaluation also failed to compile with all tests not run.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had more child-level verification artifacts below a killed workflow, but neither run reached evaluator-aligned acceptance.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run used eight subagents, one workflow, 448 tool calls, and timed out with the workflow killed shortly before evaluation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run used no subagents or workflow tasks and also timed out after local implementation work.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both exhausted the fixed budget, but parallel spent substantial budget in concurrent probes and retries whose aggregate never reached closure.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcomes are not discordant: both current status.json evaluation records completed and both report compile_failed, solution_passed false, and 869 tests not run. The concrete task-solving difference is process-level: parallel used a broad child-probe workflow and direct subagent, losing budget and artifact provenance before aggregate return, while serial remained a single-agent implementation path and failed without child coordination boundaries.
parallel_contributors: Broad workflow fan-out and retries left the spec/corpus aggregate unavailable before closure.
Shared /tmp/sdspec artifacts caused clobbered or mixed probe work and forced private scratch recovery.
serial_contributors: Serial kept probing and implementation local with no delegation or subagent result lifecycle.
Serial still timed out and failed to compile, showing the base implementation task was difficult even without parallel coordination.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both attempted custom std-only Rust regex and CLI implementations and both remained incomplete or non-compiling by official evaluation.
Serial artifact validation was false while parallel artifact packing was ok, but both official evaluations resolved to compile_failed.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained patterns are parallel adverse process events, not an explanation for a discordant score

The workflow instructed children to use unique scratch directories but also hard-coded a shared SPEC_DIR at /tmp/sdspec for all concurrent probe outputs. Parallel subagents then observed that another agent had clobbered or shared the same scratch area and moved to private work directories. That is artifact contamination in the parallel probing environment; the serial control had no child concurrency or shared subagent artifact channel.
candidates.realized_consequence: At least two probe agents had to abandon or rebuild scratch state after shared /tmp/sdspec files were overwritten or mixed with other agents, consuming verification time and weakening provenance of probe artifacts.
